title_en: Why Do Koreans Study in Cafés for 6 Hours? ☕ #shorts
description_en: Meet the kagongjok: one iced Americano, one desk, six hours. The reason is smaller than you think. Learn 카공족 (café-study tribe) and 아아 (iced Americano). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
